title: Beyond Cross-Modal Reconstruction: Participant-Level Evaluation of sEMG-Kinematic Coupling in Post-Stroke Gait
abstract: arXiv:2611.23856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate cross-modal reconstruction is often treated as evidence of physiological coupling, although it may simply reflect temporal patterns shared across participants. We tested whether frozen bidirectional models captured subject-specific neuromuscular coupling between electromyographic activity and gait kinematics in 82 held-out able-bodied and 43 post-stroke participants. Complete source-modality removal and cross-participant source substitution, along with a cycle-position-age-sex template baseline, were applied. Learned bilateral asymmetry was also compared with transparent waveform and derivative asymmetry for predicting Performance-Oriented Mobility Assessment (POMA) scores in the case of repeated nested cross-validation. Complete source removal increased reconstruction RMSE by 6.90% for electromyography-to-kinematics and 11.38% in the reverse direction. translated_title: 超越跨模态重建：卒中后步态中表面肌电-运动学耦合的参与者水平评估
translated_abstract: 准确的跨模态重建常被视为生理耦合的证据，尽管它可能仅仅反映了参与者之间共享的时间模式。我们在82名保留的健全参与者和43名卒中后参与者中，测试了冻结的双向模型是否捕获了肌电活动与步态运动学之间特定于受试者的神经肌肉耦合。研究采用了完全源模态移除和跨参与者源替换方法，并结合周期-位置-年龄-性别模板基线。在重复嵌套交叉验证的情况下，还将学习到的双侧不对称性与透明的波形及导数不对称性进行比较，用于预测以表现为导向的活动评估（POMA）分数。完全源移除使肌电到运动学方向的重建RMSE增加了6.90%，反方向增加了11.38%。相比之下，跨参与者替换仅使RMSE增加了1.68%，并且……
tldr: 该研究通过源模态移除与跨参与者源替换实验证明，冻结的双向模型确实捕获了卒中后步态中特定于受试者的肌电-运动学神经肌肉耦合，而非仅依赖参与者间共享的时间模式。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates through source-modality removal and cross-participant substitution experiments that frozen bidirectional models capture subject-specific EMG-kinematic neuromuscular coupling in post-stroke gait beyond merely shared temporal patterns across participants.
